METHOD.SCOPE: Exactly the fixed 56 known effects; target identification only
METHOD.SOURCE_READ_POLICY: Reviewed explicit ranges and minimum directly called helpers only; no source glob, import reconstruction, declaration scan, authority re-adjudication or execution of application code
METHOD.STOP_RULE: Stop once target identity is mapped; for shared targets stop at the exhausted accepted import/object-mapping boundary. Observed shared symbols are not an exhaustive ancillary-effect census.
METHOD.REFERENCE_POLICY: Full accepted reference envelopes are preserved. SOURCE_PATH_CONSUMED identifies the slices actually inspected; unrelated guard, provider and off-path references are not claimed as inspected.
METHOD.BOUNDARY_RULE: Target identity and authority proof are independent. Shared packages alone do not prove external persistence. Mixed/partially mapped chains remain exclusive target ceilings.
METHOD.DYNAMIC_IMPORT_RULE: Only the explicit auditLogs dynamic import of @/db/schema uses that same barrel export in accepted R2A metadata from other UE consumers; no importer or barrel source is re-resolved.
METHOD.PREVIOUSLY_RESOLVED_IMPORT_RULE: The profiles-query import was already resolved in the accepted census, so it is not one of R2A residual imports. Its exact importer/symbol/import edge/declaration is inherited from census accessReferences. R2A independently confirms the profilesTable/object identity and the legacy module resolution through other consumers; it does not contain this exact importer record. No import is reconstructed.
METHOD.KNOWN_DEFECT_RULE: No accepted mapping for a shared symbol is a source ceiling, not a known missing implementation. Multiple intentional targets and bounded selection are not ambiguity.
GLOBAL_EXCLUSIONS: Authorization/org-resource enforcement and guard internals are deferred to Phase 1B.2.
No transport/cache-provider internals, unselected handler branches, unrelated service methods or frozen unknown effect chains are investigated.
No table existence, deployment, runtime persistence, authorization, RLS, audit completeness or staging certification is established.
